Hero MotoCorp Appoints New Chief Strategy Officer

Hero MotoCorp has appointed Srihari Mulgund as its new Chief Strategy Officer. This appointment is a key personnel change within the company's leadership structure. Mulgund will now be responsible for the strategic direction of the automotive giant.
